item.title: StarGrid: A Brand-New Palm OS Strategy Game in 2025
item.description:
📝 Allot of 'manual' labor went into this game, no premade game engine, no additional sdk's. Coding for Palm certainly comes with it's own obstacles: - Memory is tight so you need to take into account devices that can't even keep the playing field into memory, solution there was to hide the tiles when ships are moving. StarGrid has arrived, a Brand-New Palm OS Strategy Game in 2025.
🔗 Read more: https://quarters.captaintouch.com/blog/posts/2025-10-21-stargrid-has-arrived,-a-brand-new-palm-os-strategy-game-in-2025.html

item.title: Tesla is heading into multi-billion-dollar iceberg of its own making
item.description:

item.title: Diamond Thermal Conductivity: A New Era in Chip Cooling
item.description:
📝 As we’ve crammed more and more transistors onto chips, we’ve lost the room to release that heat efficiently. We think our diamond will be even more important for advanced CMOS chips. It acts as a bridge for heat to flow into the diamond.
🔗 Read more: https://spectrum.ieee.org/diamond-thermal-conductivity
